name: Idol of the Theologian
body:
Aura moderate necromancy (healing); CL 7th; Slot none; Price 10,000 gp; Weight 1 lbs.

This moderately sized idol is carved from banded black and white onyx, showing a figure reaching upwards to the sky. Where the banding is white it appears hale and healthy, where the banding is black it appears withered and dead.

If you have a pool of theology points you can spend an hour meditating with the idol of the theologian in hand to attempt to recover your spent theology points. After this hour, make either an Intelligence or Wisdom check with a DC of 10 + twice your current number of theology points. If your check is successful, you regain 1 theology point.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Wondrous Item, lesser restoration cast as a necromancy-school spell; Cost 5,000 gp
